resource_title: Official product page and getting-started guide
data_date: current product accessed 2026-10-02; updated every six weeks

field_evidence.relationship_semantics: OS Open Linked Identifiers provides authoritative relationships between UPRNs, USRNs and TOIDs.
field_evidence.building_linkage: The product supports linking an address UPRN with a building-footprint TOID.
field_evidence.update_cadence: The product is updated every six weeks.
field_evidence.data_structure: Lookup table supplied in CSV format.
field_evidence.no_spatial_information: The official getting-started guide states that the linked-identifier CSV files do not contain any spatial information.
field_evidence.parcel_limitation: Identifier relationships do not themselves provide cadastral/title parcel polygon geometry.
